Satellite name MARSU (SPIRou/SPIP CubeSat, Millimag Astrophotometry of Red SPIRou/SPIP stars as a University space mission)
Type CubeSat
Units or mass 6U
Status cancelled
Organization Research Institute in Astrophysics and Planetology (IRAP)
Institution Institute
Entity type Academic / Education
Country France
Oneliner

Study young and active dwarfs hosting transiting close-in exoplanets
Description

Achieve continuous (duty cycle >90%) photometric monitoring in the YJH bands (1-1.8um) for stars up to H~11, at a precision better than 1mmag for up to 10min exposure times, over continuous periods of up to 3months and simultaneously with SPIRou/SPIP observations.
